280-2645-2930-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-2645-2930-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

891-6797-8207.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2438-4364-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2438-4364-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1978-5517-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.

301-4535-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

511-817-4050-6774-7824.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4939-5778-6867.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Burning-Tree Emissary that are 1/1.
When the Burning-Tree Emissary tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Burning-Tree Emissary.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.
4094-4939-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

240-3967-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

141-4668-7301.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
141-4668-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting Heliod.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath targeting Heliod.
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat from step 3.

1846-3191-4276-7202.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands
1846-3191-4276-7202.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return High Tide and Kindle the Inner Flame from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate at least three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
High Tide triggers twice for each Island tapped this way, adding that much {U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Turnabout and Kindle the Inner Flame from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 6.

4053-5499-7175--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5499-7175--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-7060.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4369-6847.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-4369-6847.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Weftstalker Ardent triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

1061-1576-7012.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-7012.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-7012.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3532-4842-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1778-2438-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

6472-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. When it enters, it triggers, returning Deceptive Frostkite from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Deceptive Frostkite's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-5231-6772.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {R}.
Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1339-2558-2981-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2558-2981-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-1778-2178-2921.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-2921.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

222-527-647-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1449-1912-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Barbarian.
When Plundering Barbarian enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1482-1492-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1482-1492-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

856-997-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-4321-5477.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

618-2732-4050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Prowling Geistcatcher with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, adding one mana of any color.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, the nontoken and token Prowling Geistcatcher's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Prowling Geistcatcher token, adding one mana of any color.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2751-4659-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, targeting any artifact.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Resolve the copy of Mishra's ability, creating a token copy of Strionic Resonator that is a 4/4 creature with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by paying {2}, and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mishra's Warform, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2103-2493-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1656-2335-4170.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1656-2335-4170.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Fain's third ability to create infinite Inklings, then use Fain's fourth ability to untap Necrotic Ooze.
You then can also use Fain's first ability to get infinite +1/+1 counters.

1135-2689-3368-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power seven or greater.
1135-2689-3368-4050.description:
Cast Kazuul's Fury by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing a creature you control with power seven or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Kazuul's Fury and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Kazuul's Fury copy, causing you to create at least seven 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Elemental Shamans, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hostility, adding {R}.
Hostility dies, shuffling itself into your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Kazuul's Fury and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Kazuul's Fury copy, dealing at least seven damage to any target.
Repeat from step 8.

1283-1518-1987-3277.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1283-1518-1987-3277.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

1771-4930.notablePrerequisites: You have more nonland cards in library than target opponent's life total.
1771-4930.description:
Cast Mana Severance for {U} {1} and remove all lands from your library.
Tap and activate Goblin Charbelcher's ability for {3} targeting a player, thus killing them.
